The official semver.org regex is:
```
^(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)(?:-((?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[a-zA-Z-][0-9a-zA-Z-]*)(?:\.(?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[a-zA-Z-][0-9a-zA-Z-]*))*))?(?:\+([0-9a-zA-Z-]+(?:\.[0-9a-zA-Z-]+)*))?$
```

The current regex:
```
(?P<major>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
\.(?P<minor>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
\.(?P<patch>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
(\-(?P<prerelease>(?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)(\.(?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*))*))?
(\+(?P<build>[0-9A-Za-z-]+(\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*))?
```

The official regex has `\d*[a-zA-Z-][0-9a-zA-Z-]*` for prerelease identifiers that start with non-numeric characters, while the current one uses `[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*` which doesn't allow identifiers starting with `0` followed by a letter.
